verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is a marketing mention of "Pagamentos em lote" (batch payments), which is the product's own bulk capability, limited to payments. The documented API endpoints for cards, VCNs, categories, cost centers, users, and transactions all appear to act on one item at a time, and paginated listing is not a bulk write. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API endpoints, bulk actions beyond payments (e.g., cards, categorization, reconciliation), detailed docs on how batch payments work, independent or hands-on corroboration.
